items.name: b11716
items.body:
<details open>

hexagon: add support for Q1_0 and Q2_0 (#30122)

* hexagon: add support for q1_0 quant

* hexagon: enable Q1_0 weights in the 2D HMX MUL_MAT path

* hex-q1: cleanup gates, generalize tiling and remove in-loop divs

* hex-tiling: document tiled formats in developer.md and update htp-tensor.h

* hex-q2: add support for Q2_0

* hex-q2: remove stale asserts and speacial cases

* hex-mm: fix MUL_MAT_NX assumption about square tiling, Q1/Q2 have non-square tiles

* hex-q1/2: minor optimizations (unrolls/un-unrolls/...)

* hex-q1: optimize Q1_0 layout to reduce unpack/vrmpy overhead

* hex-q1/q2_0: further optimize vec_dots

---------

Co-authored-by: Max Krasnyansky <maxk@qti.qualcomm.com>

</details>
